collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: Something in a villager's hut chirps all night and stops whenever anyone comes near: hunt it down, or sleep.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Something in (name1)'s hut is chirping. A loud, cheerful, relentless chirp, every few seconds, all night long. (name1) has checked the roof, the walls, the mat and the water jar. The chirping stops whenever (he/she) comes near. It starts again the moment (he/she) lies down.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) gets up for the fifth time, holds very still, and creeps toward the sound, step by step. It's coming from the basket of dried beans. (He/She) tips it out. A cricket the size of (his/her) thumb sits among the beans, looking up, apparently astonished at the fuss. (name1) carries it outside. Silence. Blessed, beautiful silence.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (name1) gives up and puts a cushion over (his/her) head. The chirping goes on. After a while, it starts to sound like a rhythm. Then a song. Then (name1) is asleep. In the morning, (he/she) finds the cricket in the bean basket, asleep too. (He/She) carries it out to the garden, a little reluctantly. That night, the hut feels very quiet.
